name: Kalalau Trail to Hanakapiai Beach
why: The first two miles of the Na Pali Coast's Kalalau Trail, high above the sea along green fluted cliffs, to a boulder beach in a jungle valley.
book: Day-use reservation for Haena State Park (entry, parking or shuttle) on gohaena.com, up to 30 days ahead. Beyond Hanakapiai a camping permit for Kalalau is needed.
water: Stream water at Hanakapiai must be treated (leptospirosis). Carry 2 litres.
dangers: Never swim at Hanakapiai: rip currents have drowned many people.
Hanakapiai Stream rises fast in rain: do not cross high water.
Red mud is very slippery after rain.
turnaround: Do not cross Hanakapiai Stream when it is high or brown.
